project.name: whatsapp-desktop
project.description: Native WhatsApp Web wrapper for Linux built with Rust and Tauri v2, featuring system tray integration, native notifications via notify-send, and memory optimization.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Application binary entrypoint configuring Linux glibc memory thresholds (MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX) and invoking whatsapp_desktop_lib::run.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Main function setting memory optimization environment variables and launching the desktop runtime.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core application library implementing WebviewWindow setup, WHATSAPP_BRIDGE JavaScript injection, system tray menu, native notification daemon calls, and clipboard helpers.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bootstraps Tauri v2 app, registers tray icon, constructs the main webview loading web.whatsapp.com, attaches close-to-tray listener, and starts background memory trim thread.

nodes.name: send_notification
nodes.summary: Spawns a detached worker thread executing Linux notify-send with WhatsApp icon and custom timeout.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Tauri IPC command exposed to webview frontend and bridge script to trigger desktop notifications.

nodes.name: clipboard_read_text
nodes.summary: Tauri IPC command reading plain text from system clipboard using arboard.

nodes.name: clipboard_has_image
nodes.summary: Tauri IPC command checking if clipboard contains bitmap image data.

nodes.name: clipboard_read_image_base64
nodes.summary: Tauri IPC command extracting raw image data from clipboard, encoding it into PNG format, and returning base64 data URI.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Cargo build script invoking tauri_build::build to compile Tauri resources and bindings.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Executes tauri_build::build during compilation.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest defining crate metadata and dependencies on tauri, arboard, image, and serde.

nodes.name: tauri.conf.json
nodes.summary: Tauri v2 configuration file specifying application metadata, bundle targets, icons, and frontend distribution directory.

nodes.name: default.json
nodes.summary: Tauri v2 ACL capability configuration granting web.whatsapp.com remote origin permissions for core webview, tray, and opener.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Node project manifest providing CLI script bindings for @tauri-apps/cli.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Diagnostic HTML interface with UI button and logging area for testing Tauri IPC notification commands.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project documentation covering Linux desktop features, WebKitGTK rationale, system tray setup, and installation steps.

nodes.name: LICENSE
nodes.summary: MIT open source license terms.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Bridge
nodes.summary: Injected JavaScript layer overriding window.Notification, polling page title for unread counters, and bridging clipboard image paste into WhatsApp input via synthetic drop events.

nodes.name: Linux Memory Optimization
nodes.summary: Multi-tier memory management using glibc MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX, and periodic malloc_trim calls to control WebKitGTK memory growth.

nodes.name: System Tray Integration
nodes.summary: Native desktop tray menu handling minimize-to-tray on close request and restore on click.
